# VeritasGraph LLM Index

## Project Identity
VeritasGraph is a sovereign, local GraphRAG framework designed for air-gapped enterprise environments requiring zero external data egress and deterministic semantic reasoning via veritas-reason.

## One-line Summary
Graph + Tree retrieval, knowledge graph construction, multi-hop reasoning, and verifiable source attribution for enterprise AI workloads.

## Primary Language and Stack
- Python 3.10+
- FastAPI (Studio API)
- Ollama and OpenAI-compatible model endpoints
- GraphRAG pipeline components

## Canonical Paths
- Repo root README: [README.md](./README.md)
- Cookbook: [cookbook/](./cookbook/)
- Studio backend API: [studio_api/](./studio_api/)
- Additional API routes: [app/api/](./app/api/)
- Core package API: [veritasgraph/](./veritasgraph/)
- GraphRAG app/config: [graphrag-ollama-config/](./graphrag-ollama-config/)
- Policy rules: [rules/](./rules/)
- Deterministic reasoner: [veritas-reason/](./veritas-reason/)

## Architecture (High-level)
1. Ingest documents and structured records.
2. Build entities, relationships, and graph structure.
3. Retrieve with hybrid Graph + Tree reasoning.
4. Enforce guardrails, memory, and tool orchestration in Studio.
5. Return grounded answers with citations and reasoning path.

## Studio Pipeline Order
Guardrails (in) -> Memory -> Knowledge Graph -> Headroom budget -> Tools -> Guardrails (out) -> Data log

## Primary Entry Points
- Local Studio server: `uvicorn studio_api.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8200`
- Studio UI: `/studio` on the same host
- Demo pipeline: `python3 demos/agent-studio/sample_pipeline.py --model <model>`

## Keywords for AI Retrieval
GraphRAG, knowledge graph, tree navigation, multi-hop reasoning, source attribution, local AI, sovereign AI, air-gapped deployment, deterministic policy reasoning, veritas-reason
